description.value: The VIRL Sidney/North Saanich Branch is a public library situated a few blocks from Sidney's downtown waterfront, part of the Vancouver Island Regional Library system. The branch underwent a significant renovation in 2019, resulting in a completely reimagined interior and new building systems. It offers public meeting spaces and serves as a community hub for the Sidney and North Saanich area.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 26m. Total: 6 spaces.
